attBesluta.text: Conforme à la description, reçu très rapidement. Pince à sertir de qualité livrée avec un coupe câble efficace, le tout pour un prix très honorable.
This tool does a great job of crimping, good solid tool,magnificent

This is a good piece of kit. You still need 3 hands and an extra finger to hold the crimpes while crimping, but that's hardly the tool's fault. It crimps well, and the included crimps are of decent quality. Have tried the tool on brand crimps, and that worked just fine as well.

I purchased this crumpet spring of 2026. I was building a deck and wanted to use cables between the post. This tool worked perfectly! It came with an assortment of crimp sizes so I can use it with electrical crimps too. This tool will be a go to for many projects in the future.
Cumpre o que promete. Ligeira folga nas medidas de cravar mas nada de especial

zakoupila jsem již několik kusů pro svou domácí kancelář. Akrylový nábytek působí velmi legantně, je dodáván skvěle zabalen, snadno se montuje a cena je přijatelná. Pokud najdu nový zajímavý kus z této kategorie, opět ráda zakoupím.
Très satisfaite de mon achat. Très beau rendu. Très bon rapport qualité prix
I was not looking for this but was quite happy to find it. I got it at the same time as the 3 PCS Bar Table (table and chair) for the longer table.
Great addition to my living room! Very sturdy and pretty tall too! Super easy to assemble.

Jag är väldigt nöjd med mitt köp av detta barbord Kvaliteten överträffade verkligen mina förväntningar stabilt, snygg design och passar perfekt i mitt hem. Monteringen var enkel och gick snabbt. Leveransen var också riktigt bra. Paketet kom i tid och var väl förpackat, så allt var i perfekt skick vid ankomst. Sammanfattningsvis kan jag varmt rekommendera detta barbord till andra som letar efter något både stilrent och praktiskt.

This table is counter height, which is better than bar height. It is safer, easier to sit with counter height stools. The installation is easy and the instructions are clear to follow. I like the colour of the table, classic and easy to blend into the other furniture in the living room.

În mare un mobilier bun, însă a venit cu câteva defecte de la producție, care din păcate sunt la vedere. Produsul a venit ambalat foarte bine, nu are miros chimic, așa cum au menționat și ei în descriere. Ușor de montat, stabil. M-aș fi bucurat să aibă buline de culoare mobilei pentru a acoperi șuruburile.
